sonnet.problem: The question says 'That means Jesus came as a real ___' and makes 'human' the right answer. The text only says 'has come in the flesh' and never states what that phrase means. Card 5 turns the phrase into its own explanation and asks the baker to supply it.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect. This includes what a picture means. He retells the picture as the text gives it and says what it stands for only when the passage says so.
